rationale: The claim involves a motor vehicle collision resulting in a totaled vehicle and personal injuries to the policyholder, which squarely fits the auto claim type under Pat Morgan's full auto coverage policy.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan (POL-1003) was rear-ended at a red light on Route 9 at approximately 8:15 AM. The at-fault driver (insurance info on police report) was traveling ~35 mph and did not brake, resulting in a totaled vehicle with the trunk crushed into the back seat. Pat sustained whiplash and a sprained wrist; injuries require medical follow-up. This is a high-severity auto claim with a $750 deductible and $100,000 coverage limit.

case_facts.description: Policyholder was rear-ended by another driver traveling ~35 mph who did not brake. Entire trunk crushed into the back seat.
case_facts.vehicle_condition: Vehicle totaled — trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.injuries: Policyholder has whiplash and a sprained wrist
case_facts.other_party: Other driver at fault; insurance info available on police report
